task_description: Transform PrestaShop 9 fork into MedBook - a dedicated Polish medical appointment booking platform. Copy and rebrand the sellnetic_booking module, add medical domain extensions (doctor profiles, clinics, specializations), integrate into the PS9 installer, create a medical-themed front-office, and add medical features (e-prescriptions, RODO, documents, online visits).

verification.summary: All 143 PHP files pass syntax checks. No remaining sellnetic references. 25 SQL tables defined. 78 admin routes. 17 theme templates. 8 email templates. Theme config valid YAML. Installer references medbook_booking module. Tests and Docker skipped - no DB available and module is new code without existing test suite to run.
